name: 宝山 2026 season comes to an end

tip.en: HR jumps from 103 to 120 bpm in about 10 seconds while pace and grade barely change — a classic sign you pushed off the warmup too fast. Yesterday's rain run had a steady ramp; this transition is sharper.
tip.zh: 心率在约10秒内从103骤升至120，配速和坡度几乎没有变化——典型的热身过快信号。昨天雨中跑的心率爬升更为平稳，这次过渡明显更急。

tip.en: At 0.7 km pace slips to 10:02 then 11:16 — likely a pedestrian obstacle or a brief stop — while HR holds at 138. This matches a pattern of unplanned pauses seen in several recent runs on this loop.
tip.zh: 0.7公里处配速跌至10:02随后11:16，可能遭遇行人或短暂停顿，心率仍维持138。这与近期在该路线多次出现的意外停顿模式相符。

tip.en: After the shuffle at 0.7 km you briefly hit 2:34/km pace — the fastest clean effort of the whole run — cresting a 5% ramp. Good instinct to re-accelerate after the disruption rather than letting cadence die.
tip.zh: 0.7公里停顿后你短暂冲出2:34/公里的配速——全程最快的有效加速——同时翻越5%的小坡。停顿后及时重新提速，而非让步频停滞，这是正确的本能反应。

title.en: HR Drifts to 150 on Gentle Ramp

tip.en: Between km 2.1–2.3 a sustained 1.5–2% grade pushes HR from 145 to 151 at a 5:52–6:43 pace that should be manageable. Cardiac drift is creeping earlier in this run than in the Sept 19 effort at similar terrain.
tip.zh: 2.1至2.3公里的1.5–2%持续坡度，以5:52–6:43的配速将心率从145推至151，这个配速本应可控。与9月19日类似地形的跑步相比，本次心率漂移出现得更早。

tip.en: Pace hits 18:11 then 41:40 min/km for roughly 25 seconds — a deliberate walk stop — and HR falls from 143 to 130. This is the longest break in the run and in any recent session; it separates the moderate first half from a noticeably slower second half.
tip.zh: 配速飙升至18:11随后41:40分钟/公里，持续约25秒——明显是刻意步行——心率从143降至130。这是本次及近期所有跑步中最长的休息，将节奏尚可的前半段与明显更慢的后半段截然分开。

title.en: Second Walk Break Exceeds One Minute
title.zh: 第二次步行休息超过一分钟

tip.en: Paces of 43:52 and 49:01 min/km at km 3.2 indicate a stop lasting well over a minute; HR slides from 142 to 116. By this point in the Sept 19 run HR was still climbing — today you are clearly managing accumulation differently.
tip.zh: 3.2公里处43:52和49:01分钟/公里的配速显示停顿超过一分钟，心率从142滑落至116。9月19日相同距离处心率还在攀升——今天你明显在用不同方式应对疲劳累积。

title.en: Repeating the Same Step at km 3.6

tip.en: The telemetry shows the same tight ramp-and-plunge sequence (grade going +5% then -11%) that appeared at km 0.8, 1.7, and 2.6 — confirming this loop circles a single set of steps repeatedly. HR response here is 136–138, calmer than earlier laps, suggesting fatigue-dampened intensity rather than better pacing.
tip.zh: 遥测数据显示与0.8、1.7、2.6公里处相同的爬坡骤降序列（+5%后-11%），证实该路线反复经过同一组台阶。此处心率136–138，比早期圈次更平稳，但这反映的是疲劳压制强度，而非配速改善。

title.en: Steepest Steps of the Loop at km 4.0

tip.en: Grade peaks near 10% for two consecutive points while HR finally nudges back to 144–145 — the first time since the second walk break that HR re-engages. This short sharp ramp is waking the cardiovascular system back up, but the subsequent descent immediately bleeds the effort.
tip.zh: 连续两个点坡度接近10%，心率终于重新回到144–145——这是第二次步行休息后心率首次重新响应。这段短促的陡坡正在重新激活心血管系统，但随即而来的下坡立刻消散了这股努力。

title.en: Strongest Uphill Effort of the Run

tip.en: Grades of 12.4% then 13.3% at km 4.6 while maintaining 5:31–5:09 pace is the best power-to-grade output of the session, yet HR is only 140–141 — lower than the same steps produced at km 0.8. Fatigue is blunting your top-end but your mechanics on this wall remain solid.
tip.zh: 4.6公里处12.4%和13.3%的坡度下仍保持5:31–5:09的配速，是本次跑步最佳功率输出，但心率仅140–141——低于0.8公里同一台阶时的水平。疲劳压制了上限，但你在这段陡坡上的动作依然扎实。

title.en: Late-Run HR Surge: Season Finale Push
title.zh: 跑步尾段心率激增：赛季终章冲刺

tip.en: From km 5.4 onward HR climbs from 145 to a session-high 157 on the final ramp series — the same ceiling hit in the Sept 19 and Sept 11 runs. Despite two walk breaks, you found a final gear; that willingness to close hard on the last loop is exactly the competitive thread worth carrying into next season.
tip.zh: 从5.4公里起，心率在最后一段坡道序列上从145攀升至本次最高157——与9月19日和9月11日相同的上限。尽管有两次步行休息，你仍找到了最后的档位；在最后一圈强势收尾的意志力，正是值得带入下个赛季的竞技基因。
